question.text: If <math><msup><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msup><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msup><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mo>…</mo><mo>.</mo><mo>.</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msup><mrow><mn>2003</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2003</mn></mrow></mfenced><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>4007</mn></mrow></mfenced><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>334</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2003</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfenced><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2002</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2001</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mo>…</mo><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2003</mn></mrow></mfenced><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2003</mn></mrow></mfenced><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>334</mn></mrow></mfenced><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced></math>, then the value of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Let,
S=12003+ 22002+ 32001+ …. + 20031 and

K=12+ 22+ 32+ …. + 20032

Adding both, we get,

S + K=20041 + 2 + 3 +…. + 2003

⇒20041 + 2 + 3 +…. + 2003=2003334x+ 20034007334

⇒ x=2005 .
